summary_notes: Odile Marchetti-Sung, bookkeeper at Ferncliff Joinery, reported reminder emails showing due dates one day early and two erroneous late fees. Tier 1 (Kwame) verified identity, updated billing email to odile.ms@ferncliffjoinery.com, and escalated to Tier 2. Priyanka identified known bug TF-88213 (UTC conversion in release 7.4) affecting all reminders since Sept 2. Late fees on INV-20417 and INV-20422 ($35 each) were caused by the same bug; one reversed during call, other to be reversed by customer. Workarounds applied: late-fee grace period set to 1 day, reminder template changed to 'Friendly reminder, no date'. Customer to confirm email change, add Junie as Staff user, and switch to annual plan before Oct 20 renewal. Summary email promised. Account attached to ticket for fix in 7.4.2.
